thread:
samir: Pasted a quick idea — a floating "halo" around active streaming replies with tiny actions: Stop • Regen • Insert Prompt. Halo appears on hover/focus. figma: https://figma.redwood/playground/halo-v1

ivy: Halo feels discoverable without permanently adding chrome. Important: make action hit targets >=44px and ensure it doesn't occlude long code blocks.

claire: Accessibility: halo controls must be reachable via keyboard (Tab into message, then arrow to halo). Use aria-labels for each action, and make streaming region aria-live="polite". Announce only chunk completions, not every token.

hugo: Token UX: show a subtle per-response token badge in the halo: "~26 tokens"; clicking it expands an inspector with cost, ETA, and a quick "compare prompt" button that opens the prompt library. Keep the inspector dismissible and focus-trapped.

samir: Good. Keyboard shortcuts: Esc to stop (when halo focused), Enter to activate primary action, and Cmd/Ctrl+P to open prompt quick palette. Avoid global collisions.

ivy: Motion accessibility: if prefers-reduced-motion, replace shimmer with static fade and don't animate halo entrance. CSS snippet: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .halo { transition:none; } }

claire: For SR users, when inspector opens move focus into it and set aria-modal="true". Announce token numbers with a short prefix: "Token count: 26" so it's clear.

tooling-bot: Analytics events proposed: playground.halo.open, playground.halo.action.stop, playground.halo.action.regen, playground.token.inspect. Include response_id and token_estimate.

hugo: Edge case: concurrent streams — ensure halo instances are keyed to response_id and don't steal focus. Regen should create new response_id and emit token_delta.

samir: Action items:
- Design: finalize halo spacing, token inspector layout (samir)
- Dev: keyboard/nav + reduced-motion (ivy, hugo)
- A11y: aria labels, focus management, NVDA/VoiceOver test (claire)
- Analytics: confirm events and payloads (tooling-bot)
If no objections I'll file UI-PL-11555 and tag eng. :thumbsup:
